lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Co4O5 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 38), with 11 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral environments throughout: Co centers coordinate to six O neighbors, while Li centers also coordinate to six O neighbors, with Co–O and Li–O distances around 2.00–2.10 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 11 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Co-centered octahedra and between Co- and Li-centered octahedra.
